items.title: College Football Playoff bracket: What 12-team field would look like after fourth 2026 CFP rankings
items.description: Texas and Notre Dame slide into the top four while the Big 12 lands three teams in the projected 12-team field after UCLA's loss shook up the rankings
items.excerpt: No. 3 Texas jumped into the first-round byes after obliterating Arkansas over the weekend, reshuffling the College Football Playoff bracket after four weeks. The Longhorns and No. 4 Notre Dame both moved into the top group after UCLA's loss, and finally moved past Alabama as the Tide's best wins atrophy. No. 1 Georgia and No. 2 Utah held the top spots on the board, with No. 5 Tennessee moving into the first home host of the first round. They'd be projected to play 12-seed Boise State in the first round. The Crimson Tide sit at No. 6 with No. 7 Miami and No. 8 Wake Forest lurking close behind.

items.title: Remembering Mike Doyle on his 80th birthday
items.excerpt: Doyle played 570 times for City – putting him third on the all-time appearances list behind only Joe Corrigan with 603 and Alan Oakes with 680. He also scored 41 goals during 14 trophy-laden seasons with the Blues. In total he won eight major honours at Maine Road – the Division Two title in 1965/66, the First Division title in 1967/68, the 1968 Charity Shield, the FA Cup in 1968/69, the European Cup Winners Cup and League Cup in 1969/70, the Charity Shield in 1972 and the League Cup in 1975/76. items.excerpt: Wales and West Ham winger Ffion Morgan is facing a lengthy spell on the sidelines after suffering an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury. Morgan has undergone surgery having been helped off during West Ham's Women's Super League win over Charlton earlier this month. The 26-year-old is now likely to miss the rest of the season. "Ffion will now begin her rehabilitation programme under the supervision of the club's medical team," a West Ham statement said. The injury also makes Morgan a major doubt for next summer's Women's World Cup, should Wales qualify. Rhian Wilkinson's side take on Norwa

items.title: A debate el proyecto de Terzic en el Athletic
items.description: El Athletic suma 16 puntos en la clasificación. Los rojiblancos son octavos pero con un partido menos que sus rivales, el aplazado ante el Rayo que se jugará el 9 de diciembre. Una vez disputado casi un tercio de Liga es momento del análisis. Ana Urquijo , Patxi Salinas , Roberto Ríos y Javi González diseccionan en MD la progresión del proyecto encabezado por Edin Terzic , que ya lleva casi cinco meses al frente del equipo. La expresidenta y los tres exleones muestras sus dudas aunque consideran que se necesita más tiempo para realizar una valoración más ajustada a la realidad.

items.title: Pochettino busca estrenar su casillero con el United
items.description: El Manchester United visita hoy al Sporting de Portugal en un duelo marcado por el estreno de ambos entrenadores esta temporada en la Champions League.
items.excerpt: El Manchester United visita hoy al Sporting de Portugal en un duelo marcado por el estreno de ambos entrenadores esta temporada en la Champions League. Mauricio Pochettino afronta una prueba importante después de debutar siendo goleado por el Liverpool. Además, los red devils necesitan sacar algo de Portugal para no complicarse la vida en la competición. El técnico argentino, que seguirá teniendo bajas sensibles como Rashford, vuelve a la Champions, competición en la que en su día alcanzó la final. items.title: Los entresijos de la ovación de Anfield a Andoni Iraola

items.description: Pubblicato il bando, due i format alternativi: classico oppure allargato a 56 squadre

items.title: CFP selection committee finally gets it right with Tennessee, Indiana rankings
items.description: The Volunteers are getting the credit they deserve, while the Hoosiers finally got burned after weeks of playing with fire
items.excerpt: The College Football Playoff selection committee finally did it. For the first time this season, the rankings…made sense. I wasn't filled with confusion and frustration over what the committee decided. Instead, the committee made decisions that seemed to emphasize resumes and metrics over ambiguous "eye test" considerations. The committee finally ended its love affair with Alabama and moved the Crimson Tide three spots. items.title: Michigan matches worst start by reigning national champion in last 40 years: Why pressure is on Mike Boynton
items.description: The Wolverines will need to turn things around quickly or Boynton won't be back for a second season
items.excerpt: Michigan dropped to 3-3 on Tuesday with a 99-73 loss to Creighton in its opening game of the Players Era 16, matching its loss total from last season's national title team. The Wolverines are now tied for the worst six-game start by the winner of the previous season's NCAA Tournament in the last 40 seasons. The only other reigning national champions that started 3-3 during that stretch? UConn (2014-15), UCLA (1995-96) and Louisville (1986-87).
